periods.summary: Sirius is introduced as Stella's intensely doting father and Vermillion's king. He previously demanded that Ikki visit Vermillion after Seven Stars, but secretly prepared a national interception plan: citizens, the army, bounties, royal guards, and Dandalion are all used to keep Ikki from the castle. His scheme collapses when Ikki reaches the castle and Lunaeyes broadcasts the truth. After Stella breaks down in anger and grief, Sirius is cornered by his family and agrees that if Ikki brings victory in the upcoming war against Quedolan, he will consider accepting the marriage.

key_events.summary: His covert plan turns Ikki's arrival into a nationwide test.
Is forced to accept the war-victory condition for Ikki and Stella's engagement.

periods.time: Ikki's stay in Vermillion and the first invasion day
periods.label: 以情义优先的法米利昂国王

name.jp: シリウス・ヴァーミリオン

status.current: injured in the palace by Ein's Thorn Whip after ordering Vermillion to save Quedland
status.condition: hands and legs disabled by severed tendons; still alive

relationships.stella-vermillion: Beloved daughter; initially clings jealously to her but later asks her to be Vermillion's sword.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Future son-in-law candidate; tests him absurdly, then formally lets him prove himself in war.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Wife whose political judgment he respects but sometimes overrules from the heart.
relationships.clef-cobrand: Old friend and partner in reconciliation with Quedland, whose murder enrages him.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Daughter whose safety he fears after the Luxel ambush.

periods.summary: Sirius tries to recover paternal dignity by challenging Ikki to simulated combat, arm wrestling, and a marathon, losing every time while learning how formidable and sincere Ikki is. When Stella reports that Or-Gaule is controlling Quedland's people, Sirius rejects the coldly rational option of hiding the truth and ordering lethal defense. He tells General Signa that Quedland's army has no true hostile will, commands the army not to kill or die, and declares that Vermillion will save Quedland because thirty years of shared trust cannot be discarded. He also accepts Ikki's role as a Vermillion representative if Ikki can lead the country to victory. During the palace attack, Sirius resists Ein's pollen paralysis with Blazing Great Axe but is quickly disabled by Thorn Whip.

key_events.summary: Challenges Ikki in multiple trials and loses while revealing his jealous fatherly affection.
Orders the army to save Quedland's controlled soldiers rather than kill them.
Fights Ein after she poisons the palace but is crippled by her thorn attack.

abilities: warrior instincts despite impaired left eye

relationships.astrea-vermillion: Wife who handles palace aftermath and joins citizen support offscreen.

periods.summary: Sirius's decision to fight Quedland with nonlethal riot gear expresses his loyalty to Quedland but gives Lunaeyes grounds to criticize him for risking Vermillion lives. After Caldia he rushes to confirm his daughters' safety and reveals an unexpected helper protected the palace. He wants to take the fifth representative slot as king and knight, but Nene bluntly rejects him as a liability in a Desperado-class melee. While Stella goes to Edelberg, he worries and asks Nene if she should have stopped her. On the eve of war he tries to help citizens prepare the national funeral vigil by supplying palace alcohol, only to be scolded by Lunaeyes.

key_events.summary: Arrives after Caldia and debates Lunaeyes's negotiation and his earlier orders.
Attempts to volunteer but is rejected by Nene.
Supports the citizens' vigil despite evacuation orders.

personality.summary: Blunt, fiery and possessive as a father, but ultimately places his daughters' happiness above royal convenience.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Future son-in-law candidate; Sirius rejects his explanation emotionally but keeps the promise to judge him by sword.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Beloved daughter whose growth and danger drive his anger toward Ikki.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Eldest daughter; he permits her to renounce succession and follow John despite loneliness.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Wife who sees through his loneliness and shares war viewing.

periods.summary: During Vermillion's state funeral, Sirius explains to Ikki that Vermillion funerals are loud because the living must laugh so the dead will not regret leaving loved ones in sorrow. He then confronts Ikki over the report that Ikki stopped Edelweiss from saving Stella during her near-death awakening. Although furious as a father, Sirius tests Ikki's reasoning. Ikki says he loves Stella and therefore could not obstruct her chosen identity as the Crimson Princess; Sirius cannot accept this as a father but confirms that the earlier promise still stands: Ikki must prove himself with his sword if he wants Stella. Later, Lunaeyes privately announces that she will renounce succession to stay beside John. Sirius recognizes that John is the true personal reason and, despite the political cost and his own loneliness, tells Lunaeyes to go do what only she can do. Watching the war afterward, he complains about losing a daughter but has already chosen her happiness over keeping her in Vermillion.

key_events.summary: Explains funeral customs and challenges Ikki about Stella's near-death trial.
Flashback reveals Sirius permitted Lunaeyes to renounce succession and rescue John.

relationships.nene-saikyo: Ally whose earlier warning not to approach her training makes Sirius fear her oni transformation may become uncontrollable.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Daughter and representative fighting in Luxel.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Daughter watching the broadcast beside him.

periods.summary: Sirius watches the broadcast of Nene and Naseem's battle with Vermillion's citizens. When Nene first appears to defeat Naseem he is relieved with the crowd, but her later oni-like Overdrive worries him. He recalls that before the war, when Nene trained alone after seeing Stella off to Edelberg, she warned him not to let anyone approach her and showed hints of horns and a dangerous expression. As citizens cheer that Nene can match the monster, Sirius alone fears the next problem: even if that 'oni' defeats Naseem, there may be no guarantee she can control herself afterward.

key_events.summary: Recognizes the danger of Nene's transformation from an earlier encounter and fears she may lose control.

name.jp: シリウス・ヴァーミリオン

status.current: alive after joining the Luxel battlefield and visiting Ikki's hospital room
status.condition: protective, emotional, and still comically overreactive about Stella and Ikki's intimacy
status.goal: protect Stella, Vermillion's people, and the civilians caught in Or-Gaule's schemes

fears: Ikki dying because of impossible odds
any man getting too close to Stella

relationships.stella-vermillion: Beloved daughter; he rushes to protect her and later worries over her relationship with Ikki.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Future son-in-law candidate; he recognizes Ikki's terrifying ability but still reacts jealously to intimacy.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Wife who restrains his overreactions and prioritizes serious matters.
relationships.or-gaule: Enemy whose attacks he helps block while protecting Shizuku and Ikki.

periods.summary: While watching Ikki versus Alice, Sirius correctly reads that Invincible Armor's resilience makes the fight almost impossible and grows furious that Ikki did not keep Stella with him. When Or-Gaule unleashes Quedland civilians as puppets, Sirius appears on the battlefield with the royal guard and fanatical Stella supporters, physically blocking the human tide so Stella can keep fighting. Later, during the final Or-Gaule battle, he stands before Shizuku and Ikki's remains and uses his flaming axe to block a thread attack, declaring that he is Stella's father and will not let Or-Gaule pass. After Ikki wakes in hospital, Sirius and Astrea rush in with news about Tatara. Sirius erupts when he finds child-sized Ikki and Stella kissing, but Astrea subdues him so the urgent matter can be discussed.

key_events.summary: Arrives with royal guard forces to restrain puppet civilians.
Protects Shizuku and Ikki from Or-Gaule's attack during the final fight.
Visits the hospital with Astrea and interrupts Ikki and Stella.

flaws: anger can derail negotiations until Astrea intervenes

relationships.stella-vermillion: Beloved daughter whose kidnapping enrages him.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Queen who manages the actual diplomacy when Sirius is too angry.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Future son-in-law; Sirius complains but has allowed the marriage after Ikki fulfilled his promise.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Initially berates him for the kidnapping but later trusts his rescue strategy.
relationships.john-cobland: Son-in-law through Lunaeyes; physically drags Sirius away so talks can proceed.

periods.summary: When Itsuki reports Stella's abduction, Sirius explodes in rage, demanding Japan deploy all forces and threatening war if Stella is harmed. Astrea has John drag him away so diplomacy can continue, but Sirius returns calmer after hearing Itsuki's plan and recognizes the parental motive behind it. He agrees that Vermillion will act according to Itsuki's strategy in Union politics. In the autumn, Sirius and Itsuki are among the parents who have already advanced Ikki and Stella's wedding arrangements; Sirius still complains as a doting father but has accepted the marriage.

key_events.summary: Reacts furiously to Stella's kidnapping, then agrees to cooperate with Itsuki's rescue diplomacy.
Has already consented to and helped arrange Ikki and Stella's wedding.
